item: Row 394: a superseded analysis run never writes on its failure path either
summary: loadAnalysis bumps _anRunSeq and checks stale() after every await, but a REJECTED await skipped the check: its catch wrote the old run's error into a panel the newer run had already painted (keywords, mind map, When/Where/Who, links, sentiment, sources) and then wrote the next panel's Loading line. Every catch now returns first when the run is stale. The same hole closed in _anLoadArtFacets (an old failure blanked the newer corpus's chips), _anLoadArticles (its failure message, and the page clamp now keeps its run), loadAnContext (an old concordance or its failure landed on the newer chips; it now takes the run), renderAnTrend (no key check after either await), renderAnRelated and renderAnCompetitive (their catches) and renderAnPrice (run or commodity changed). A run that is still current shows its failure as before. No new strings.
